title: 高盛23亿美元收购ETF供应商Neos，押注期权策略赛道
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Goldman Sachs will pay up to $2.25 billion to buy provider NEO's investments, giving the firm a sizable position in options-based strategies that promise investors income, downside protection,
segments.zh: 高盛将支付最高22.5亿美元收购NEO's Investments，从而在期权策略领域占据重要地位，这些策略为市场参与者提供收益、下行保护或其他明确结果。

segments.en: or other defined outcomes. Joining us now is NEO's Sipes of Bloomberg Intelligence to put this acquisition in perspective. When I say up to $2.25 billion, it's cash and equity that it's paying,
segments.zh: 现在请到彭博智库的NEO's Sipes，为我们解读这笔收购。当我说最高22.5亿美元时，这是以现金和股权支付的，但最低和最高是多少？为什么会有变动？

segments.en: but what is the minimum and what's the maximum here? Like, why is there a variable?
segments.zh: 是的，我认为你看到的头条数字包含了盈利支付，对吧？

segments.en: Yeah, so I think the headline number that you see it includes earnouts, right?
segments.zh: 在资产管理交易中，你通常看到的是你既购买了策略，这里是指衍生品收益型主动ETF领域的两项大规模策略，同时你也在引进**人才和销售人才。

segments.en: You typically see that with asset manager deals is you're buying both the strategy and in this case two very large-scale strategies in the derivatives income-active ETF space, but you're also bringing
segments.zh: 显然会有业绩门槛和增长目标，达到这些目标可以将价格提升至22.5亿美元。这是为了对冲这笔昂贵交易的部分风险。

segments.en: in the investment talent, the sales talent as well, and so there's obviously going to be performance thresholds, growth objectives that they hit that can lift that number to $2.25. So that's a way to
segments.zh: 昂贵交易，这正是我想问的。那么这笔交易有多贵？当我看到这个，我们团队今早有一份报告，看起来这两家创新者和NEO's的交易相比资产管理行业通常情况要贵得多。

segments.en: sort of hedge some of the risk for a pricey transaction that we saw here. So pricey transaction, that was the question I wanted to ask. So how pricey is this? When I look at this, we have a note
segments.zh: 你能谈谈它在规模上有多贵吗？你的看法是什么？你认为这合理吗？

segments.en: out this morning from my team. This looks like both of these innovators and NEO's were pretty pricey transactions compared to what we usually see in the asset management industry. Can you just talk about
segments.zh: 是的，我认为这当然合理，而且你说得对，它确实贵。我们估计它大约占资产的7%到8%，这是一个粗略的上限。

segments.en: how pricey is it on scale? Like, what are your thoughts on this? Do you think it makes sense?
segments.zh: 这个价格高不高？你怎么看？你觉得合理吗？

segments.en: Yeah, I think it certainly makes sense and I think you're right. It is pricey. We have it somewhere between seven and eight percent of assets, which is an easier top of the envelope so to speak.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为这确实合理，你说得对。这价格不菲，我们估算约占资产的7%到8%，可以说是相当高的水平。
